db:select.db:sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(last_reported_upto, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS upto, last_sequence_number FROM compliance_report_control WHERE entity_code = :entity AND report_type = :rtype

set-variable.value: #[{ start: payload[0].upto, end: ((payload[0].upto as LocalDateTime {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}) + |P1D|) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"} }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Variable

db:select.doc:name: Select flagged transactions
db:select.db:sql: SELECT t.transaction_id, t.transaction_datetime, t.account_number, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, t.transaction_type, t.channel, t.currency, t.amount, t.counterparty_name, t.counterparty_country, f.flag_code, f.flag_reason, f.flagged_at, f.reviewed_by, f.review_status FROM transactions t JOIN transaction_flags f ON f.transaction_id = t.transaction_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE f.flagged_at >= :periodStart AND f.flagged_at < :periodEnd AND f.report_status = 'PENDING_REPORT' ORDER BY f.flagged_at, t.transaction_id

logger.message: #["Page " ++ (vars.counter as String) ++ ": rows=" ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String) ++ ", first=" ++ payload[0].transaction_id]
